name: Locked Tripod Shot
prompt: Use a locked tripod camera with no pan, tilt, zoom, roll, shake, reframing, or focal-length change.

name: Slow Cinematic Push In
prompt: Move the camera in one slow smooth push toward <Subject 1>, keeping the horizon level and the subject centred without acceleration.

name: Slow Pull Back Reveal
prompt: Move the camera in one smooth pull back that gradually reveals the environment while preserving perspective and screen direction.

name: Full 360 Degree Orbit
prompt: Perform one smooth full 360-degree orbit around <Subject 1> at constant radius, speed, height, and focal length.

name: Gentle 180 Degree Arc
prompt: Move through one gentle 180-degree arc around <Subject 1> with constant distance, level horizon, and continuous screen direction.

name: Side Tracking Shot
prompt: Track beside <Subject 1> at matching speed with stable framing, constant camera height, and no unwanted orbit or zoom.

name: Low-to-Eye-Level Rise
prompt: Raise the camera smoothly from a restrained low angle to eye level without tilting the horizon or changing subject identity.

name: Handheld Documentary Light
prompt: Use restrained documentary-style handheld movement with subtle human drift only, avoiding harsh shake, rolling shutter, or sudden reframing.

name: Macro Detail to Medium
prompt: Begin on a clearly defined close detail and pull focus and framing smoothly to a stable medium shot without a jump cut.
